use tree_sitter_language_pack::get_parser;

fn main() {
    let name = r#"nonexistent_xyz"#;
    let parser = get_parser(name);
    match parser {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
